setup.title: Setup guide
setup.description: Follow these steps to export a player list from Football Manager 27 or 26 and import it into this app.

players.title: Players
players.description: Score and rank players by a weighted average of their attributes. No baseline needed: import and go.

wonderkids.title: Wonderkids
